decisions.reason: Margin analysis runs on the firm's maintained market data, adds value for utilities at low marginal cost and fits the platform expansion.
Gas tariff comparison is core-adjacent, uses the shared daily updated databases and remains in demand among suppliers.
The regional electricity tariff calculator is a core product with its own page and steady demand, so dropping it makes little sense.
The energy tariff calculator line may overlap with C, but it is more likely to be consolidated into the platform than withdrawn.
The area definition tool underpins the other location-based products and supports the integrated platform strategy.
Site-specific tariff comparison models are cheap to maintain on shared data and serve existing customers, despite limited website prominence.
